en: The image shows an old sepia-toned postcard depicting a large, ornate building on a prominent city square. The architecture is grand, likely late 19th or early 20th century, with a dome and decorative façade. In front of the building is a monument or fountain with statues, and several early automobiles and a horse-drawn carriage are visible, indicating an early 20th-century setting. The text on the postcard is in Hungarian.
